sp._warning: S&P initial rating BBB+ assigned with 2022 bond issuance

fitch._warning: Fitch initial rating BBB+ assigned with 2022 bond issuance

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Initial public rating tied to Louisville/Jefferson County Metro Government Series 2022A/B Health System Revenue Bonds; cited strong FY2021 net income $96.5M; recovered post-KentuckyOne integration

outcome_class_rationale: UofL Health entered window unrated, received initial BBB+/stable from S&P and Fitch in 2022 in conjunction with first public bond issuance; entity strengthened through window. (Subsequent BBB downgrades occurred in 2024-2025 — outside window.)

ma_events_2021_2022._warning: Announced accelerated 4-year repayment of KEDFA loan (originally 15-year) citing positive FY2021 financial performance
